palette: paddy-chart pale green ground + wheat and paddy parcel panels + boundary-red survey lines + dark field notes + brass benchmark marks
typography: field-note headings on parcel panels, dark survey label tabs with brass left bar, red boundary lines for ownership divides, red stamps reserved for verdicts, thin ink underline for tests
composition: the ownership bands map as three parcel strips with mnemonics; the three economies stand as a wheat-paddy column row with a distribution strip; the property scene divides public sacrosanct from private protected beside a Weimar note
surface: flat pale green chart ground with faint survey hairlines, parcel panels with hairline weathered borders and corner benchmark dots, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: boundary lines draw between parcels, parcels fill with wheat and paddy tones, economy columns rise in canon, the red verdict stamps land once
transition: the surveyor rolls the chart and the field clears for the next plot
